purpose: Qualify the exact SWAP 4.3.1 KSATEXM conductivity extension inside the already-qualified homogeneous unsaturated face envelope h=[-10000,-1] cm without changing the Ross table architecture, node count, memory ceiling or runtime complexity.

source_trace.release: SWAP 4.3.1 frozen audit package supplied to this project

source_semantics.activation: KSATEXM is effectively enabled only when the input contains KSATEXM and KSATEXM > KSATFIT; fill_cofgen then sets fluseksatexm for the node.
source_semantics.macropore_guard: hconduc uses the extension only when swmacro == 0; C2A has no macropore physics, so this condition is satisfied.
source_semantics.extension_condition: if fluseksatexm and S > S_thr and swmacro==0
source_semantics.continuity: At S=S_thr the base Mualem-VG law and the extension both equal K_thr; the implementation uses the base branch exactly at the threshold because the condition is S > S_thr.
source_semantics.wet_limit: As S approaches 1 from below the extension approaches KSATEXM.
source_semantics.input_validation: SWAP rejects a layer when K_thr >= KSATEXM after KSATEXM activation.
source_semantics.implicit_derivative_limitation: SWAP 4.3.1 dhconduc explicitly rejects the KSATEXM linear-interpolation branch for swKimpl=1. C2A therefore does not use legacy dhconduc as an oracle for future Ross response tangents.

separation_from_h_enpr.statement: KSATEXM and H_ENPR are distinct SWAP constructs. The KSATEXM transition threshold is fixed at h=-2 cm in readswap and is applied in hconduc through relative saturation. H_ENPR controls modified-VG retention/conductivity behaviour in a separate branch.
separation_from_h_enpr.c2a_h_enpr_scope: All frozen Staringreeks 2018 catalog entries have H_ENPR=0, so C2A does not qualify non-zero H_ENPR physics.

frozen_candidate.interpolation: bilinear in log mobility, arithmetic in float64

selection_rationale.O12: maximum normalized extension slope near saturation
selection_rationale.B05: minimum S_thr and widest extension interval in S
selection_rationale.O14: maximum S_thr and previous C1 interpolation stress
selection_rationale.O05: maximum K_thr/KSATFIT and previous C1 interpolation stress

oracle_policy.steady_face_equation: same independent Ross steady one-dimensional Darcy oracle as Gate B/C1R, with only K(h) replaced by the source-bound SWAP 4.3.1 KSATEXM law
oracle_policy.piecewise_integration: adaptive quadrature must split at h=-2 cm whenever the integration interval crosses that conductivity-derivative seam

exit_rule.characterization_pass: freeze C2A representation unchanged and create a fresh 36-material KSATEXM holdout before any catalog qualification claim
exit_rule.characterization_fail: reject C2A N241 representation fail-closed; any redesign must be a new characterization contract before holdout access

scope_guard: C2A only. No h>-1 cm, no saturation switching, no non-zero H_ENPR, no heterogeneous faces, no timestep accuracy, no bottom boundary, no groundwater, no MultiSWAP production claim, no response-tangent admission and no FullRichards equivalence.
